issue_title: BM25Retriever scores <0 filtered out even with algorithms that allow it
issue_body:
**Describe the bug**
Recently this PR was merged that set `scale_scores` to False by default: https://github.com/deepset-ai/haystack/pull/6717
Tagging you here @shadeMe since you were involved in that PR. 

However, some BM25 algorithms, including our default one Okapi, allow for negative scores and we end up filtering those too.

This was discovered in the solution of the advent challenge for day 5 where a community member reported a new kind ex out of bounds error showing up, which was caused because the retriever stopped returning anything: https://github.com/deepset-ai/haystack/discussions/6441#discussioncomment-8194537

**Expected behavior**
If the algorithm allows for negative scores in the first place, maybe we shouldn't filter them out? 

**To Reproduce**
Run the solution colab by removing the fix. I fixed the colab by setting the BM25 algorithm to "BM2Plus". Remove this and you will get an empty list as a result: https://colab.research.google.com/drive/1JzO8lkrb4DtnkPgKnaZkngZeHcfAWQQ5?usp=sharing#scrollTo=WOTZW1ja_8L5
